entities.summary: Smooth-sided pyramid; the black pyramid was built by king amenemhat iii during the middle kingdom of egypt. it is one of the five remaining pyramids of the original eleven pyramids at dahshur in egypt. Pyramid of Amenemhat III is a archaeological site from Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
